cohort: Patients who underwent postpartum hysterectomy between January 2004 and December 2013 at Fauji Foundation Hospital, Lahore, Pakistan.
finding: The incidence of postpartum hysterectomy was 1.09/1,000 deliveries, with the most frequent indication being morbidly adherent placenta previa (80%).
mod_finding: 13 postpartum hysterectomies were performed after cesarean delivery and 2 after vaginal delivery.
